 The Police Inspector of Giri nagar P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 3 for the offences punishable U/s. 498A,
506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Bhgya Shree K.B.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 married CW-1 on 14-02- 2019 as per Hindu rites and customs.
Prior to marriage, the Accused No.1 to 3 demanded and received dowry of Rs.Ten lakhs cash, gold ornaments from parents of CW-1.

After marriage, while CW-1 was residing with Accused No.1 at the house of accused at Tirupati, the Accused No.1 to 3 used to physically and mentally harass CW-1 in demand of additional dowry from her parents and extended cruelty.
CW-1 unable to bear the harassment, she went to  3  C.C.No.35349/2022 her parents house.

When CW-1 was residing in her parents house,
the Accused No.1 came to the house of CW-3 and criminally intimidated CW-1 to get additional dowry.

Based on the information of Smt.Bhagya Shree K.B., a case in Cr.No.157/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the offences U/s. 498A, 506 of IPC., and Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
 3.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused No.1 to 3 in the language known to them, to which, the accused No.1 to 3 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The  4  C.C.No.35349/2022 plea of the accused No.1 to 3 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused No.1 to 3 as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with as there were no incriminating evidence against the Accused No.1 to 3.
 6.
Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No.1 to 3 caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her with dire consequences and thereby Girinagar Police Station vs Madana Mohan on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178107507/
3  accused has committed the offences punishable  U/s.498A, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of  D.P.Act..?

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.35349/2022  REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement and Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. Smt. Bhagyashree the CW-1 was examined as PW-1.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 14-02-2019 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never threatened her with dire consequences.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.

The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 Girinagar Police Station vs Madana Mohan on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178107507/
4 as hostile witness and cross examined her.

entities.text: PW-1 Girinagar Police Station vs Madana Mohan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: During which PW-1  6  C.C.No.35349/2022 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
Though PW-1 was cross examined by the prosecution, nothing worth could be elicited.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.1 to 3 are C.C.No.35349/2022 acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
